

`internal/review/metrics.go`: nil-safe
`Metrics` with the six families this part owns:
`worklode_review_rounds_total{subject,client}`,
`worklode_review_threads_total{intent}`,
`worklode_review_open_threads{subject}` (gauge, set from a count query after
each thread write), `worklode_review_question_latency_seconds` (buckets 5,
15, 60, 300, 900, 3600), `worklode_review_time_to_verdict_seconds` (300,
1800, 7200, 86400, 604800), `worklode_review_verdicts_total{verdict,
reviewer_kind}`. `NewMetrics(reg prometheus.Registerer)`; `serve.go`
constructs it and passes it in `api.Config.ReviewMetrics`. Part 3 adds the
two skim families to the same struct.

`internal/api/reviews.go`, routes in `routeGuards`, each with a `routeDoc`:

```
POST /api/v1/reviews                                  guardedAny(permDocWrite)
GET  /api/v1/reviews                                  guardedAny(permDocRead)
GET  /api/v1/reviews/{id}                             guardedAny(permDocRead)
POST /api/v1/reviews/{id}/threads                     guardedAny(permDocWrite)
POST /api/v1/reviews/{id}/threads/{tid}/messages      guardedAny(permDocWrite)
POST /api/v1/reviews/{id}/threads/{tid}/resolve       guardedAny(permDocWrite)
GET  /api/v1/docs/{id}/threads?version=&anchor=&status=   guardedAny(permDocRead)
GET  /api/v1/rules/{id}/threads?version=&status=          guardedAny(permDocRead)
POST /api/v1/docs/{id}/threads                        guardedAny(permDocWrite)
POST /api/v1/threads/{tid}/messages                   guardedAny(permDocWrite)
POST /api/v1/threads/{tid}/resolve                    guardedAny(permDocWrite)
```

The last five are WL-REQ-1323 v3's bare-note and thread-list routes. The
two lists serve `ThreadsForSubject`, bare notes and review threads together,
`obsolete` included, and take `model.DocThreadsParams` and
`model.RuleThreadsParams`. `POST /docs/{id}/threads` opens a bare note
(`OpenThread` with `reviewID = 0`) with either a section anchor or a range
anchor; a range on a spec is mapped by Task 7, so a thread on "a document or
one of its arranged rules" is one route. The thread-scoped reply and resolve
share handlers with the review-scoped pair (Decisions).

Each write goes through `eventbus.Emit` with the store function as
`apply`, the way `docs.go`'s `recordDocEvent` does; add a
`recordReviewEvent` helper next to it rather than a second copy of that
plumbing. Errors map as the doc handlers map them (`ErrNotFound` 404,
`ErrForbidden` 403, `ErrInvalidInput` 422, `ErrConflict` 409). The `GET
/reviews/{id}` response is `model.Review` with threads, messages and rounds
embedded; `lode review show --json` is this object. `GET
/api/v1/reviews?subject=&reviewer=&state=` takes one `model.ReviewListParams`
with `query` tags (`queryrule_test.go`), as do the two thread lists.

First handler test: open a review over a spec as its owner, open a question
as reviewer `a` (a second token) with a range of the rendered spec that
falls in a rule's text, assert the stored thread names the rule, reply as
owner, resolve as `a`; assert statuses, then scrape the test registry for
`worklode_review_threads_total{intent="question"} 1` and one observation on
`question_latency_seconds`. A bare note through `POST /docs/{id}/threads`
with a section anchor reads back from `GET /docs/{id}/threads?anchor=sec-N`
beside the review thread, and `GET /rules/{id}/threads` lists the question.
A range crossing from a rule into template text is 422. Extend
`TestMetricsEndpointDomainFamilies` with `worklode_review_rounds_total` and
`worklode_review_open_threads`.
